Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE full-body static NPC map sprite for planetary mode. The reference sheet shows ALREADY APPROVED pixel sprites. Strictly match their extremely low-resolution NES-like style, chunky simple pixel clusters, proportions and limited palette. This is NOT a dialogue portrait and NOT ASCII. Follow the specified species column, changing only the job clothing and equipment.
Actual target is 24x24 RGBA PNG. Design on a single exact 24x24 logical pixel grid, each pixel a flat solid square. Full character 22 logical pixels tall, front-facing neutral standing pose, centered with feet on row22 and a transparent row below. Head about 6-8 logical pixels high including headgear; body and separated boots clearly readable. Width roughly human12, vessari10, muroth16 logical pixels; tiny tools may add 2 pixels. At most eight opaque flat colors plus actual transparency. Large simple solid shapes; no antialiasing, blur, gradients, texture, dithering, glossy effects, subpixel details or smooth curves. If output is enlarged, enlarge logical pixels with perfectly crisp squares; do not add any detail. No ground shadow, text, border, grid lines, frame, background or extra character. Preserve thin transparent gaps between legs and around arms. Keep both feet visible. Use light skin/shirt contrast and visible dark slate trousers rather than pure black trousers.
Species: Human: warm tan skin, simple dark eyes, rounded human ears, slim upright body. Match Human A in the reference.
Job: Miner: red/rust work overalls with dark straps and boots; compact protective helmet/headband with a light that leaves alien ears or crest readable. Hold one short gray mining pick at the side, contained within the tile silhouette. No supervisor shirt.
